augmentation: Per-image random crop from 4-pixel zero padding and horizontal flip, on training only (unchanged CIFAR trainer).
checkpoint_selection: Minimum validation cross-entropy, as in the frozen CIFAR trainer.
quaternion_encoding: q = B08(NIR) + B04(R) i + B03(G) j + B02(B) k; NIR in the real part is a choice, not canonical.
scope: Second dataset for the compression studies: identical CNN6 widths, optimizer and epoch budget as CIFAR; only the four-band input differs. The 5,400-image test split is held out and NOT evaluated here. Quaternion and real models differ in widths and compute; they are not matched-cost models.
